crossRefs.note: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.

translations.web: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.
translations.bsb: Each of these cities had its own surrounding pasturelands; this was true for all the cities.
translations.kjv: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
translations.asv: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus it was with all these cities.
